# MoreCarry

**Category:** Exploit  
**Aliases:** MoreCarry

## What it does

MoreCarry lets you use the four crafting slots in your inventory as extra item storage. Normally, any items left in those slots are dropped or cleared when you close your inventory, because the client sends a "close container" packet to the server. This module intercepts and cancels that packet, preventing the server from clearing those slots — so whatever you place there stays put.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/exploit/morecarry). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
